evidence_items.locator: section 'State-of-the-art reasoning with unprecedented depth and nuance', paragraph 2

receipt.public_excerpt: It tops the LMArena Leaderboard with a breakthrough score of 1501 Elo. It demonstrates PhD-level reasoning with top scores on Humanity’s Last Exam (37.5% without the usage of any tools) and GPQA Diamond (91.9%).

evidence_items.explanation: Shows Gemini 3 Pro at or near the top of major benchmarks at launch.

receipt.public_excerpt: The model outperforms all other models in Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. It demonstrates strength across the board, coming in first in 5 of the 10 evaluations that make up Intelligence Index.

evidence_items.explanation: Independent confirmation that Gemini 3 Pro led overall at launch, though it led only half of the component evals.

receipt.public_excerpt: Demis Hassabis, Chief Executive Officer of Google DeepMind, said the world is “still not there” when it comes to artificial general intelligence (AGI), describing current AI systems as powerful but inconsistent and limited.

evidence_items.explanation: Months after Gemini 3 launched, Google DeepMind's own CEO said AGI had not been reached. This backs the 'not AGI' part, though it is dated after the target period.

unresolved_gaps: The 'not AGI' evidence I could read is dated after launch; the December 2025 Axios interview could not be read.
